rationale: The standalone host gains an opt-in Musical Typing keyboard, reached from the macOS Window menu or Cmd+K. One transferred surface moves with it: WindowOptions grows a menu_commands list so a host can publish native application-menu entries, and WindowHost gains one query, is_gpu_backed(), appended at the tail of the vtable so an SDK subclass keeps its existing slot layout. The macOS hosts that install those menu entries live in macos-shell-deferred, which is not framework-authoritative-transferred, so it is not covered here. This is Pulp-specific standalone-host product work — playing a Pulp instrument without a DAW — and has no counterpart framework behaviour to backport.
